title: Identification of Biomarkers for Stress Vulnerability and Resilience
official: Identification of Biomarkers for Stress Vulnerability and Resilience
summary: The purpose of this research study is to understand the biological mechanisms of stress vulnerability (being susceptible to stress) and stress resilience (being able to recover readily from stress), obtain biomarkers (a biological indicator) for stress resilience and to devise strategies for prevention and treatment of stress-related disorders.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Incoming Freshmen Students at the University of Michigan

Exclusion Criteria:

* Suicidal Ideation
